rules_review.finding: Returning a selected unit or spell from trash targets that public-zone card. The selection must finalize before responses. A different identical copy or a departed-and-returned copy cannot replace that target. Open battlefield permission requires both no units and no controller.

implementation_notes.Sai Scout: Reuse MayPlayToOpenBattlefield and printed Vision, including private Predict ordering after the play and inherited location prohibitions.
implementation_notes.Cemetery Attendant and Annie: Add a typed shared return-from-trash trigger. Reuse the existing public trash-selection controls and stable selected-copy tracking; adapt the copy-removal, pending-payment detach/restore, recycle, and burnout paths together.
required_scenarios: Both players, multiple eligible copies, mandatory choice, wrong kind, empty trash.
Choices finalize before opposing responses; remove an earlier index, remove the target, remove and return an identical card, and source removal.
Payment cancellation of another action restores the original target identity; completing it invalidates that identity.
AI legal choices, serialized API, native trash-card selection and companion teaching; full match conservation.
implementation_notes.scope: Additional legal Irelia options; not a claim of current meta prevalence. Source review alone does not admit a card to playable coverage.
